text: See bd-01KZXD7G0E5KEDMC2VCGVKGNS7, filed before residual streaming is built. residual_block() is not block-plan invariant (0.5-4 ULP across block sizes 1/2/3/4/6). Since Epic 5 accumulates residual cross-products in bounded blocks and inverts the result, the memory budget perturbs the metric: measured Sigma drift 1.99e-16 amplifying to K drift 1.74e-12 at cond=1.68e5, i.e. ~1e4 amplification. At the cond>=1e8 typical of unshrunk local searchlight covariance that reaches the default expect_equal tolerance. Either reduce residuals canonically with the existing .canonical_reduce machinery, or declare metric construction block-plan dependent and record the block plan in the recipe signature.
